program.name: SPP3 Marketplace RFP
program.authority: SPP3 Committee under the DAO-approved Marketplace RFP and SPP3 committee model

application.applicantName: Illustrative Applicant — not a real submission

rules.description: Live product or credible go-live path measured in weeks
Primary deliverable is a service to ENS
No active committee conflict under SPP3 standards
Applicant is not a ratified SPP3 cohort provider

eligibility.rationale: Illustrative record only. No real applicant eligibility determination is represented.

evidence.description: Public Marketplace RFP authorization, scope, award structure, milestones, and committee rules.
Marketplace RFP timeline, eligibility gate, M1–M5 rubric, threshold, payment structure, and committee process.
SPP3 committee model defining quorum, voting, committee roles, and accountability.

decision.authority: SPP3 Committee; a subsequent ENS executable vote funds the selected award
decision.rationale: Illustrative pending record. No real committee judgment is represented.
decision.quorum: Three of four SPP3 Member seats active and participating
decision.decisionRule: Simple majority of participating SPP3 Members; the Chair votes only as a tiebreaker.

challenge.scope: The reviewed public Marketplace RFP and SPP3 process artifacts do not identify a post-decision process for correcting factual errors or procedural deviations. This records the public-process mapping and does not assert that no internal or unpublished procedure exists.

deliveryConditions.description: Go-live milestone with objective acceptance criteria.
deliveryConditions.reviewWindow: Defined in the eventual service agreement.
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: Independent verification defined in the service agreement; the stream pauses if go-live is missed without committee approval.
deliveryConditions.verifier: SPP3 accountability body or designated verifier
deliveryConditions.consequence: The build stream may pause if the required go-live milestone is missed.

deliveryConditions.description: Post-go-live traction gates tied to marketplace usage.
deliveryConditions.reviewWindow: Defined in the eventual service agreement.
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: On-chain or otherwise independently verifiable evidence such as attributed protocol revenue, active wallets, completed secondary sales with anti-wash filters, or retention.
deliveryConditions.verifier: SPP3 accountability body or designated verifier
dependencies: Final thresholds are negotiated using baseline data at award signing.
deliveryConditions.consequence: Unreleased amounts return to the DAO treasury at term end.

redactions.explanation: The public RFP states that submissions are stored confidentially during review; this example uses a fictional applicant.

notes: This is a non-evaluative worked example.
It does not identify, score, recommend, or reject any real Marketplace RFP applicant.
The public-process mapping is based on artifacts reviewed on 2026-08-15.
The correction-path field is diagnostic and does not propose changing the rules of the active review.
